RECOMMENDATION: DON'T RAISE IT
LIKELIHOOD: 20

The demographic makeup of the panel alone is not evidence of discrimination. Public broadcasters typically use structured competency criteria, and the successful candidate possessed specific digital media expertise that likely aligned more closely with the role's strategic priorities than overall tenure. 

Alleging bias based solely on the panel's gender composition is unsubstantiated and could severely damage your professional reputation and working relationships within the organization. 

Instead, professionally follow up on your requested written feedback, keeping the focus entirely on competencies, scoring, and development areas. Only consider raising formal concerns if documented feedback or credible evidence demonstrates an explicit procedural breach or discriminatory conduct.
